//: OPTIONAL power-user settings for the Leo-Solarized theme.
The theme is self-sufficient WITHOUT this file: it maps a full set of
tree-sitter capture names directly (classes, namespaces, enums, params,
decorators, members, builtins, ...), which Zed applies always-on with no
LSP and no settings required. See ADR-0004.
This file only adds what tree-sitter CANNOT know: LSP semantic facts.
`semantic_tokens` MUST be enabled for the rules below to fire at all —
it is off by default, so without this line the rules do nothing.

global_lsp_settings.//: Dim (and let Zed strike through) symbols the language server marks
@deprecated — a purely semantic property tree-sitter has no way to see.
